headline: Reserve Bank of India Probes Irregular State Bond Deals by Banks
summary: The Reserve Bank of India launched an investigation into suspicious trading activity in state development loans, examining whether banks engaged in circular trading to artificially support prices.
why: Regulatory probes into sovereign and state bond markets safeguard financial system transparency, preventing valuation distortions in domestic bank portfolios.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Regulatory investigations into state debt markets raise compliance scrutiny for domestic lenders.
